messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error-rate detected for ingress in euc2 (ALB). 5xx spike >20% over 5m. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. Link: https://monitoring.example/alerts/2790011111

alex (oncall): ACKed. I'm on it — looking at ALB targetgroup health and envoy stats now.

mira: seeing a sharp increase in TCP RSTs from node IPs in euc2b to backends, envoys show repeated TLS handshakes then RST. Samples: envoy upstream reset_reason=connection failure, downstream_local_reset.

jp: cloud status shows "Partial networking disruption in eu-central-2b" (provider incident id 2026-ec2b-net-472). Notified provider.

sam: customer impact: Hosted API error rate ~24% for the last 6m, top errors are 502/504 and connection reset. On a few customer support threads users report timeouts when hitting hosted endpoints in EU.

alex (oncall): initial mitigation plan: 1) remove targets in ALB targetgroup that are flapping in euc2b, 2) shift weighted routing away from euc2b to euc2a + fallback region, 3) toggle cross-zone balancing to attempt smoother distribution. Doing step 1 now.

mira: running quick checks — kubectl and envoy snippets:
```
# check ingress controller pods and restarts
kubectl -n ingress get pods -o wide
# tail envoy for a flapping host
kubectl -n ingress logs deploy/istio-ingress -c envoy | tail -n 200
```

alex (oncall): Removed 3 targets from ALB targetgroup tg-0a1b2c in euc2b (marked unhealthy). Triggering a small weighted DNS change via Route53 to shift 30% traffic off euc2b to euc2a for now.

eng-infra-bot: automated change: Route53 change-request submitted change-id ZR12345. New weights: euc2a=0.65, euc2b=0.05, eu-west-1=0.30. Propagation ETA ~60s.

jp: after weight shift we still see elevated RSTs from the remaining euc2b NAT gateways. Provider confirms packet drops on some egress paths in euc2b.

sam: customers on dedicated capacity show fewer errors (isolated), shared hosted customers hit the worst. Impact summary being compiled for CS.

alex (oncall): quick fallback: enabling NLB-backed targetgroup as a hot spare for the critical route that was failing. Creating new targetgroup and registering healthy instances in euc2a and eu-west-1.

mira: one-off kernel-level symptoms noted on nodes in euc2b: ephemeral port exhaustion and high TIME_WAIT. Running commands:
```
# check conntrack and ephemeral ports
ss -s
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count
```

jp: provider pushing network rollback in euc2b; they say a NAT upgrade deployment caused transient state on border devices. They rolled back and are monitoring.

alex (oncall): after Route53 change and registering NLB targets, 5xx rate dropped from 24% -> 6% in 10m. Still seeing occasional spikes for flows that continue to route through euc2b caches.

sam: CS update: proactively messaged top 10 affected customers, asking them to try hitting eu-west-1 as a temporary region; CS will update status page with partial outage messaging.

mira: recommended longer-term mitigations: add cross-AZ connection draining timeout increase, tune node ephemeral port allocation, and add NLB fallback for critical ALB routes. Raising infra ticket INFRA-993 to track.

alex (oncall): handing off primary mitigation to jp for follow-up with provider and cleanup — I need to step off pager for the next rotation. Handoff summary: Route53 weights adjusted (change-id ZR12345), removed tg-0a1b2c targets, registered NLB tg-n1 as fallback, monitoring for re-intro of euc2b targets.

jp: taking over. I'll keep monitoring until provider confirms stable. Next steps: coordinate postmortem, attach relevant logs and timeline, and schedule kernel/conntrack tune to staging.

eng-infra-bot: alerting: postmortem template prefilled: https://docs.example/incidents/2790011111/postmortem-draft

alex (oncall): thanks team — nice quick pivot. :thumbsup:

jp: provider just confirmed euc2b border rollback completed and initial metrics look healthy. I'm going to gradually increase euc2b weight back in 5% increments while watching 5xx.

mira: current metrics: 5xx global now 0.9%, euc2b origin 5xx down to 1.8% (was 24%). No new spikes in last 15m.

jp: marking this thread for "monitor until end of day" and starting postmortem draft. If things reflare ping @jp and @mira.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: monitoring only. Root cause (prelim): provider NAT/border device rollback caused intermittent packet drops and TCP resets in eu-central-2b leading to ALB target health oscillation and high upstream reset rates. Mitigations: route53 emergency weight shift, ALB target isolation, NLB fallback, kernel/conntrack follow-up.

sam: I've posted a short customer note in support console and linked the status page. Will escalate to account leads for the biggest customers.

jp: closing thread for active mitigation. Postmortem doc: https://docs.example/incidents/2790011111/postmortem-draft — will fill action items (INFRA-993, CS notify, provider RCA). Thanks everyone.
